runs.t: Specification-driven development starts with an explicit, testable description of required behavior before implementation. In AI-assisted work, the specification is the agreement between the human architect, agent and verification process.

Document actors, use cases, inputs, outputs, constraints, invariants, error behavior and acceptance tests. Keep requirements separate from a suggested implementation so an agent can choose mechanisms without redefining business rules.
A hotel cancellation specification defines who may cancel, refund windows, inventory release, notification policy and retry behavior before anyone generates controllers or database models.
Overly prescriptive specs constrain harmless design choices; vague ones create plausible but wrong code. Resolve contradictory examples and record open questions before delegating.

Agent brief:
Give an agent a cancellation feature brief and ask it first to extract invariants, ambiguities and acceptance tests. Only then permit implementation within declared module boundaries.
Review criteria:

items.t: State the expected behavior and at least one failure or edge case before asking an agent to implement anything.
Inspect the boundary conditions and dependency direction, not only the happy-path result.
Demand observable evidence: tests, measured results, or a justified design decision.

Вимагайте перевірювані докази: тести, вимірювання або обґрунтування проєктного рішення.
